subject: Pen test report sharing - sanitized exec summary + secured access proposal
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquila.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security-request@aquila.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for pen test report and remediation status (NDA)

Hi Jonas,

As part of Aquila's vendor risk review for Q2, our security team needs access to Redwood's latest penetration test report and an exec summary of findings and remediation status. We can proceed under a mutual NDA; attached is our standard sharing addendum. Please let me know:

- Whether you can share the full report under NDA, or if you prefer a redacted/sanitized exec summary first.
- Typical turnaround for redaction and whether you provide a secure viewer (watermarked) for high-sensitivity findings.
- Snapshot of remediation status for high/critical findings (we only need current status, not raw evidence).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Aquila Bank
security@aquila.com

Attachment: Aquila_Vendor_Sharing_Addendum_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquila.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report and remediation status (NDA)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the addendum. We can accommodate your request. Quick proposal to balance confidentiality with your review needs:

1) Immediate: we will share a redacted Executive Summary PDF that includes scope, timelines, high/critical findings (sanitized), and a remediation status table. That will be provided as an attachment and via our secure viewer (watermarked, view-only).

2) Full report access: available under our mutual NDA plus a short carveout that specifies on-site/secure-viewer access only for high-sensitivity sections. Alternatively, we can provide a time-limited secure link for Aquila's security team to review the full findings without download.

3) Timeline: exec summary + sanitized findings: 48 hours. If you need full-report secure access, legal review + redline acceptance typically takes 5–7 business days.

I've attached the sanitized exec summary and a spreadsheet of findings for quick consumption. Laura (Legal) is looped in to confirm NDA language. Aditya (Security Ops) will prepare the secure viewer link and remediation snapshots.

Next steps: let us know whether Aquila can accept view-only access for full-report review or prefers a fully redacted package. Also indicate who on your team will need access (names + emails).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-1298

Attachments: redacted_pen_test_exec_summary_2028-03.pdf (application/pdf); sanitized_findings_2028-03.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquila.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report and remediation status (NDA)

Sarah — looping in legal comments on Aquila's sharing addendum. We appreciate the vendor security process; a couple of required clarifications before we can grant full-report access:

- We request a mutual NDA with an explicit prohibition on public disclosure and a narrow permitted-use clause limited to Aquila's internal security review.
- For the full report, Redwood requires view-only access via our secure viewer for high-sensitivity sections (no downloads). If Aquila's team must extract raw evidence for internal tooling, we can discuss an evidence-exchange workflow with escrow.
- Please confirm retention period for our shared artifacts on Aquila's side (we prefer 90 days).

If those are acceptable, we can sign the addendum with the above edits and provide the full secure-viewer link. I have attached a redline of the addendum for your review.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: Aquila_Vendor_Sharing_Addendum_v3_REDLINE.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@aquila.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report and remediation status (NDA)

Laura — thanks for the quick review and clear asks. Aquila can accept:

- Mutual NDA with non-disclosure and limited permitted use.
- View-only secure access for high-sensitivity sections; Aquila requests a read-only window for up to 21 days (we can agree to your 90-day retention for copies we store).
- We do not expect to extract raw evidence; our team will document findings in our own tracker.

I'll confirm the names/emails of the reviewers by COB today. Once the redline is updated I'll circulate for internal sign-off.

Best,
Sarah
